subject: Acceptance lanes & legal sequencing — playbook for MSA/DPA/order form alignment
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@bluecrest.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>; laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@bluecrest.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance lanes & sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. BlueCrest is excited to move to a pilot, but procurement/legal asked for a short mutual action plan so they can coordinate internal reviewers across Compliance, Legal, and IT. They sent over a list of gating items that map to our MSA/DPA and the order form — primarily: SOC2 evidence, data retention terms, and the billing cadence on the order form.

Can we propose a minimal playbook that BlueCrest can circulate to their stakeholders (timeline, owners, blockers)? Ideally we want to lock the commercial terms and signature window by July 10 to enable the pilot start July 21.

Attachments: BlueCrest_gating_list.xlsx (procurement), sample SOC2 matrix referenced in body.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of IT Procurement
BlueCrest Labs

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@bluecrest.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance lanes & sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Emily —

Appreciate the clear ask. I sketched a short playbook below that maps the BlueCrest gating list to owners and target dates. This is intentionally tight so procurement can see a clear path to signature. Notes inline where we anticipate legal/tech questions.

Playbook (high level):
- Week A (Jun 16–20): Legal/IT discovery call (we provide SOC2 snapshot and KMS/HSM diagram). Owner: Laura. Deliverable: SOC2 evidence bundle + short answers doc.
- Week B (Jun 23–27): Contract redline cycle (MSA + DPA). Owner: BlueCrest Legal (Tom) + Laura. Deliverable: Redlines consolidated; flag non-standard clauses.
- Week C (Jun 30–Jul 3): Order form alignment + billing cadence confirmation. Owner: Markus + BlueCrest procurement. Deliverable: OrderForm_Draft.xlsx + invoice schedule.
- Week D (Jul 7–10): Final approvals & signature window. Owner: Exec sponsors. Deliverable: Executed MSA/DPA/OrderForm.

Key dependencies:
- If BlueCrest requests non-standard data residency restrictions we will need Private deployment review — adds 2 weeks.
- Any DPA changes affecting subprocessors require legal review and an additional round of signoff.

Attached: initial MSA with suggested accept-lane comments (BlueCrest_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf).

Next steps: Laura will set the discovery call for Jun 17. Vanessa will track the HP/HubSpot deal and create the MAP doc we can both edit.

Would you like the playbook converted into a one-page timeline PDF for exec circulation?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@bluecrest.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance lanes & sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Hi all —

Thanks for the plan, Markus. Quick legal notes from my review of BlueCrest_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf:
- Section 5 (Data Processing) — propose a single-point DPA appendix that references our standard subprocessors list (we can provide consolidated exhibits).
- Security evidence — SOC2 snapshot is fine for the pilot. If BlueCrest needs continuous evidence or penetration test reports, that moves us to an enterprise intake and delays signature.
- Acceptance criteria — recommend including a short operational acceptance clause in the order form: 14-day pilot acceptance window with specific pass/fail criteria (latency SLA and data isolation checks). This prevents ambiguous signoffs.

I'll join the discovery call on Jun 17. My ask to BlueCrest: please confirm the legal reviewers' names and whether procurement needs an internal PO created before signature. If they need PO-first, we should push the target signature window earlier (to avoid delays).

Attachments: notes_redlines_20250612.txt (inline comments).

-L
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@bluecrest.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance lanes & sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form

Emily / team —

Thanks — sending this summary so procurement can paste directly into their MAP and circulate. I created a living MAP in HubSpot (link below) and attached the draft order form. Please review owners and target dates; if BlueCrest confirms Tom (Legal) and a procurement PO requirement, we will update the schedule.

Summary playbook (copy/paste friendly):
- Jun 17: Legal/IT discovery call (Laura + BlueCrest IT) — deliver SOC2 evidence bundle and KMS diagram.
- Jun 23–27: Contract redline consolidation (BlueCrest Legal + Laura) — consolidate redlines, mark critical vs. discretionary.
- Jun 30–Jul 3: Order form alignment (Markus + BlueCrest procurement) — finalize billing cadence and acceptance clause.
- Jul 7–10: Final approvals & sign (Exec sponsors) — target signature by Jul 10 to enable pilot start Jul 21.

Action owners: Laura (legal), Markus (commercial/order form), Vanessa (MAP maintenance + HubSpot record).
Ops notes: If BlueCrest requires PO-before-signature, notify by EOD Jun 11 to rebase timeline. If private deployment is requested, expect +2 weeks to the schedule.

HubSpot MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789/DC-8721
Attachments: OrderForm_Draft.xlsx (stub)

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the discovery on Jun 17 10:00 AM PT.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
